operational_definition: Routine workflow actions recorded or dispatched by the rule-based campaign agent
relationship_to_total_operations: This is the total campaign-agent operation count; the other activity metrics describe overlapping subsets or complementary views and should not be summed to this value.
scope: Primary production only: five final systems, RH 0.90/0.30/0.10 strict-production chain.

relationship_to_total_operations: Overlaps with campaign-agent operations as one class of routine execution activity; not additive with analysis, decision, archive, or transition counts.
scope: Primary production strict-pass states only; obsolete, smoke, RH0.7, and quarantined artifacts excluded.

operational_definition: Post-segment analyses followed by a continuation, archive, or review decision
relationship_to_total_operations: Overlaps with campaign-agent operations and corresponds one-to-one with simulation cycles; not an independent component to add to 414.

operational_definition: Recorded validations of restart, archive, or state-transition consistency
relationship_to_total_operations: Overlaps with campaign-agent operations as provenance-management activity; low-level internal file-stat checks are not separately enumerated.

operational_definition: System--RH simulation states written to the authoritative final archive
relationship_to_total_operations: Overlaps with campaign-agent operations as final archive actions; also defines the accepted campaign state count.
scope: Five systems x three RH states final strict-pass dataset.

operational_definition: Successor RH states initialized from accepted predecessor states
relationship_to_total_operations: Overlaps with campaign-agent operations as state-progression/provenance activity; not additive with archive or provenance-check counts.
scope: Primary production strict-pass chain; five systems times two downstream transitions.

operational_definition: Simulation states that could not be safely resolved by the approved workflow rules
relationship_to_total_operations: Complementary review-state count; it does not imply a reasoning-agent invocation.

operational_definition: Non-interactive invocations of the Codex CLI reasoning agent, powered by GPT-5.5, during formal production
relationship_to_total_operations: Independent reasoning-agent-invocation count for formal production; zero means no automated reasoning-agent invocation occurred during production and does not mean the rule-based campaign agent was inactive.
scope: Formal primary production only; excludes planning, software development, validation tests, retrospective replay, and human-assisted debugging.
